common.error_unknown: Something went wrong. Check the Home Assistant log and try again.

routines.title: Routines
routines.empty: No device has a routine yet. Opt a device in below, then set its times.
routines.opted_out: {device} is opted out. Its routine is off and is cleaned up after the clean up period.

detached.title: Detached routines
detached.description: These routines were taken over in the automation editor and are normal automations now. Open the automation to change one.

devices.title: Add devices
devices.description: Devices with an entity a routine can drive. Suggested devices are already switched at set times by an automation.
devices.empty: No device has an entity a routine can drive.

today.title: Today
today.empty: Nothing is scheduled on this day.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Defaults apply to routines created from now on; changing one never rewrites an existing routine. Saving reloads Device Routines.

schedule_scope.name: Schedule sensor scope
schedule_scope.description: Which devices get a Schedule sensor: every device an automation acts on, only devices with a routine, or none.

time_format.name: Time format
time_format.description: How times read in every sentence. Automatic follows the country set in Home Assistant.

default_catch_up.name: Catch up after a restart, for new routines
default_catch_up.description: After a restart, the device is put in the state its schedule expects.

default_respect_manual.name: Respect manual changes, for new routines
default_respect_manual.description: A device someone switched by hand stays as it is until its next scheduled time.

default_late_start_window_min.name: Late start window in minutes, for new routines
default_late_start_window_min.description: How long after a missed start time a new routine may still start its device. 0 turns late starts off.

cleanup_after_days.name: Clean up after, in days
cleanup_after_days.description: How long a routine and its helpers stay after their device is opted out or removed. 0 keeps them.

assign_area.name: Put routines in the device's area
assign_area.description: Give each routine automation the area of its device, so it shows on the area page.

on_removal.name: On removal
on_removal.description: What removing Device Routines does to the routine automations.

ai_task_entity.name: AI summary entity
ai_task_entity.description: An AI Task entity id, or empty to keep AI summaries off. The options of Device Routines say what is sent to it.

ai_calls_per_hour.name: AI calls per hour
ai_calls_per_hour.description: The most summaries the AI summary entity writes in one hour.

offer_conversions.name: Offer to convert matching automations
offer_conversions.description: Offer, in Repairs, to turn a hand written automation that does exactly what a routine does into a routine.

raise_conflict_repairs.name: Raise Repairs issues for conflicts
raise_conflict_repairs.description: Raise a Repairs issue when a routine and another automation switch a device in opposite directions at the same minute.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Every action is safe to run at any time. A preview shows what would change before anything does.

rebuild_index.name: Rebuild index
rebuild_index.description: Find every routine automation again from its markers and the registries.

reinstall_blueprint.name: Reinstall blueprint
reinstall_blueprint.description: Put the shipped blueprint back when the installed file differs or is missing.

clean_up_now.name: Clean up now
clean_up_now.description: Remove the routine, helpers and controls of every opted out or removed device now, without waiting for the clean up period.

refresh_summaries.name: Refresh summaries
refresh_summaries.description: Read every automation again and rewrite every Schedule summary.

health.title: Health
health.missing: The Health sensor of Device Routines is not available.
